summary: Banzai International filed an 8-K disclosing a September 25, 2026 subscription agreement under which CEO and Chairman Joseph Davy purchased 115,965 shares of Class B common stock at $0.70 per share, for aggregate cash proceeds of $81,176. The price equals the consolidated closing bid of the Class A stock immediately preceding execution; the shares were issued in an unregistered private placement exempt under Section 4(a)(2). Following the purchase, Davy holds a 25.6% voting interest. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is an insider financing rather than a change-of-control event; watch for dilution, governance concentration, and further affiliated placements.
